import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int N = (1 << 20) + 5;
    static int n, lim, ans;
    static int[] p1 = new int[N];
    static int[] p2 = new int[N];
    static int[][] flag = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] a = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] h = new int[10][10][10];

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = (int) ((long) res * x % mod);
            x = (int) ((long) x * x % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int inv(int x) {
        return fpow(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] aArr = {x, y, z};
        int[] d = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (flag[aArr[d[0]]][1] != 0 && flag[aArr[d[1]]][2] != 0 && flag[aArr[d[2]]][3] != 0)
                return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(d));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] d) {
        int i = d.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && d[i] >= d[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = d.length - 1;
        while (d[j] <= d[i]) j--;
        swap(d, i, j);
        reverse(d, i + 1, d.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] d, int i, int j) {
        int temp = d[i];
        d[i] = d[j];
        d[j] = temp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] d, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(d, start, end);
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            int xVal = 1;
                            while (xVal == i || xVal == j || xVal == k) xVal++;
                            int yVal = xVal + 1;
                            while (yVal == i || yVal == j || yVal == k) yVal++;
                            int zVal = yVal + 1;
                            while (zVal == i || zVal == j || zVal == k) zVal++;
                            sta |= h[xVal][yVal][zVal];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            p1[sta] = (p1[sta] + P) % mod;
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y] = 1;
        if (y == 3) dfs1((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        flag[x][y] = 0;
        if (y == 3) dfs1((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) sta |= h[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            p2[sta] = (p2[sta] + P) % mod;
            ans = (int) ((ans + (long) p1[lim ^ sta] * P % mod) % mod);
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y - 3] = 1;
        if (y == 6) dfs2((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 4);
        else dfs2((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        flag[x][y - 3] = 0;
        if (y == 6) dfs2((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 4);
        else dfs2((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int) ((long) a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int tot = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    h[i][j][k] = 1 << tot++;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        lim = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= lim; j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    p1[j] = (p1[j] + p1[j ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs2(1, 1, 4);
        ans = (mod + 1 - ans) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
